_comment: Ids a duty template may never use. Two prefix rules live in scripts/validate.py: `butler-` is the Butler team's namespace and is maintainer-only (pass --maintainer or set MAINTAINER=1 to publish one); `bevo-` is the container's own bundled-command namespace and is refused outright. Everything listed here is an entrypoint-written or bundled dir/command name an installed template would collide with; scripts/validate.py embeds a mirror of this list so its standalone copy needs nothing beside it (tests/test_validate.py asserts they agree).
